response.note: Assumes method_family = 'card' identifies card payments and status <> 'success' marks failed/declined attempts (not verified against actual values); ranks issuers by count of failed card attempts in August 2026.
response.sql: SELECT issuer_id, issuer_name, issuer_type, COUNT(*) AS declined_attempts, SUM(amount_inr) AS declined_amount_inr FROM v_attempts_clean WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' AND method_family = 'card' AND status <> 'success' GROUP BY issuer_id, issuer_name, issuer_type ORDER BY declined_attempts DESC LIMIT 50
